description: MUTATES Raisely data: publishes a post (a campaign/profile update). Raisely API: POST /posts with the body wrapped as { data: {...} }. Required by the API: path (the post's URL slug), body (the content), photoUrl. Link it to a profile via profileUuid (pass through `fields`). Extra fields (title, date, ...) via `fields`. Returns the created post.

body.description: The post content/body. Required by the API.

fields.description: Additional documented Raisely fields to send in the JSON write body's `data` object — merged OVER the typed fields above.

path.description: The post's URL slug/path. Required by the API.

photoUrl.description: URL of the post's photo. Required by the API.

name: create_post
title: Create a post
